title: importMesh
body:
## importMesh

Prepare a closed STL mesh as a faceted Part solid with explicit length units, winding and frame, then compose native refinement and solid machining.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- STL has no assigned unit: units scales coordinates from mm, cm, m or inch into millimetres. Explicit reverseWinding flips every facet; it does not repair inconsistent local winding.
- Planning admits at most 32 MiB per file and 20000 facets across the document. Closed directed edges and vertex fans are necessary; native valid-solid/BOP checks also refuse disconnected or intersecting material and incorrect cavity winding.
- The source becomes a static faceted Part::Feature with editable Placement and optional linked Part::Refine. Native Part cuts remain editable. Original analytical surfaces, colours and mesh-feature history are not recovered; mesh repair and scan fitting remain unfinished. Continue checked stock with bodySeed for an ordered Body history; see docs/freecad-body-seeds.md.
- Saved verification reconstructs the complete typed Part graph in a trusted private worker and binds source triangles to independently parsed retained STL. It never restores the submitted native document. See docs/freecad-mesh-preparation.md.

Native binding: `Part::Feature`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

Inputs: none.

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | Existing binary or UTF-8 ASCII STL containing one consistently oriented closed material region, possibly with inward-facing cavity shells. Planning bounds each file to 32 MiB and the document to 20000 facets. Exact captured bytes support later verification after the original is removed. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":4096}` | **required** |
| `units` | The unit of each STL coordinate: mm, cm, m or inch. STL does not assign units itself; this option scales coordinates by 1, 10, 1000 or 25.4 into millimetres. Binary coordinates retain their original single-precision quantization. | `{"type":"enum","values":["mm","cm","m","inch"]}` | **required** |
| `reverseWinding` | Reverse every triangle when the entire STL is consistently inverted. Default false preserves authored winding. Outer surfaces must face outward and cavity surfaces inward; mixed winding, holes and nonmanifold geometry require a repaired source file. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
| `orientation` | Map signed file axes into a right-handed part frame before world placement. Default z=+Z and x=+X preserves the file frame. Choose a perpendicular x when using a non-Z up direction. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"z":{"type":"enum","values":["+X","-X","+Y","-Y","+Z","-Z"],"default":"+Z"},"x":{"type":"enum","values":["+X","-X","+Y","-Y","+Z","-Z"]}}}` | `{"z":"+Z"}` |
| `placement` | Place the oriented part in the world frame: clocking rotates about world Z in degrees, then position supplies world X/Y/Z translation in millimetres. | `{"type":"object","properties":{"position":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3,"default":[0,0,0]},"clocking":{"type":"number","minimum":-360,"maximum":360,"default":0}}}` | `{"position":[0,0,0],"clocking":0}` |
| `refine` | Default false retains all admitted triangular faces. True adds linked native Part refinement to merge redundant coplanar boundaries; saved verification binds the original facets and checks that refined material stays unchanged. Native Part operations use the refined output. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
